# UMBRA

> Voice chat platform for gaming communities — Star Citizen orgs, milsim units, and competitive clans. Cross-channel whisper (command talks to each squad without leaving their channel), push-to-talk on HOTAS/gamepad/Stream Deck, a tablet command app, built-in planning tools (calendar, notes, whiteboard), and community-funded servers: no per-user subscription — the whole community sustains its server with contribution units called "lingotes" (ingots), so the leader never pays alone. Runs on Windows and in the browser (no install). 15-day free trial, no credit card. In early access since July 2026, by CFX. Available in English and Spanish.

Key facts:
- Whisper between rooms is configured in seconds and works from desktop, browser and tablet.
- Push-to-talk binds natively to HOTAS sticks, gamepads and Stream Deck keys.
- Servers are funded collectively: members chip in ingots toward a monthly quota (~$10–$200/month equivalent depending on size).
- If funding lapses, the server freezes but is never deleted — it comes back when refunded.
- Not yet available: screen share, video, self-hosting, native macOS/Linux clients (browser works there).
